question: What should come in the place of blank number **4?**
solution:
The correct answer is '**Boundless**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The writer's imagination is compared to a "**well**." In literature, a well of imagination implies a source of ideas.
 
• The narrator is "**amazed**" by this imagination, suggesting it is vast and never-ending.
 
• "**Boundless**" (असीम/बेहिसाब) means having no bounds; infinite or vast. This is the only word that fits the positive and awe-struck tone of the passage.
 
• "**Shallow**" (Option 2) means lacking depth, which contradicts the narrator's amazement.
 
• "**Stagnant**" (Option 3) means showing no activity or dull, which is the opposite of the "vivid" world described.
 
• "**Predictable**" (Option 4) means behaving in a way that is expected, whereas the narrator felt they were discovering "another world."

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

Complete Passage Segment: *The used bookstore was not merely a location where one might purchase books; it was a refuge. The air was thick with the earthy, rich smell of paper and dust, an odd fragrance which was at once soothing and (1) overwhelming__. I would spend hours there, running my fingers over the spines of ancient, forgotten books that stood on the shelves. Each novel was another world to discover, and I finally removed a leather-bound book with an odd, yellowed title. Its pages were dry and (2)__fragile__ . to the touch, as if one careless turn would make them disintegrate. As I picked up to read the opening lines, the words didn't merely speak a tale-they whisked me off to a whole different world, a place of magical creatures, gallant heroes, and secret spells. The vocabulary was old-fashioned, but impossibly (3)__vivid__, describing gaudy pictures in my head that were more real than the creaky aisles surrounding me. I was amazed by the imagination of the writer, a well that was presumably truly (4)__boundless__. I felt a rush of awe, an appreciation that these tales, as ancient as they were, remained supremely (5) _________ and capable of igniting the imagination of a new generation.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Metaphor:** The use of "well" is a metaphor for a deep, inexhaustible source of creativity.
 
• **Awe (विस्मय):** A feeling of reverential respect mixed with fear or wonder.
 
• **Inexhaustible:** A strong synonym for boundless often used in competitive exams to describe creativity or resources.
